statement: Solver exact and aggregate source verification classify package-lock.json as content-bound source so a dependency reclassification cannot reach terminal handoff with an aggregate fingerprint that omits the lockfile.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

requiresSourceVerification returns true for the root package-lock.json while preserving every existing source-verification prefix and workflow/product classification. Nested or similarly named files are not broadened unless already covered by an existing source prefix.

A focused regression proves the root lockfile is content-bound and that a canonical aggregate over package.json plus package-lock.json changes when either file changes. The companion service-cli-pg-runtime-dependency-v2 aggregate must recompute to the independently established four-path fingerprint after this fix lands.

Production scope is scripts/solve/change-artifact.js only, with one focused test and one scenario runner. Rejection-supersession behavior, artifact formats, handoff commit behavior, unrelated Solver work, and product runtime behavior are unchanged.

Independent verification must show reverting the package-lock.json classification turns the focused scenario red, approve exact and aggregate fingerprints, and confirm the existing verification-handoff suite remains green.
